name: H-E-B Manufacturing - Houston Snack Plant (Genard Road) - Houston TX

fieldNotes.location: 10000 Genard Rd, Houston TX 77041 confirmed - roster ROOFTOP geocode (moved 4 m) landed correctly on the snack-plant building. Verified by satellite (manufacturing building with heavy rooftop process equipment and corn/grain silos consistent with a tortilla-chip plant) and web research.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The snack plant sits within the large fenced H-E-B Houston manufacturing campus. Campus perimeter has decorative metal fencing, but no barrier arm, sliding gate or guard booth was positively identified at the campus entrances in satellite or Street View - entrances appear as open paved driveways. Classified false but flagged uncertain; a controlled campus gate may exist out of the imagery probed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at the snack-plant area or campus entrances probed.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The snack plant is one building in a large multi-building H-E-B campus that also contains the Windfern Rd RSC, the milk plant and the bread plant.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large trailer drop yards flank the plant - a major drop yard immediately south and additional trailer parking to the NE; campus-wide drop yards extend well beyond.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed into docks along the plant's NE/E face; estimated ~16 doors - 10-25 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band - the south drop yard alone holds dozens of trailers.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs through the broader campus to the SE, but no spur serves the snack-plant building itself.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: NW Houston - dense urban/suburban industrial fabric, residential immediately adjacent.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~14 acres for the snack-plant building and its immediate drop yards; the full H-E-B campus is far larger.
fieldNotes.buildingDescription: Roster cites 46,000 sq ft (some sources 64,000 sq ft); opened mid-2019; produces plain and flavored tortilla chips.
